title: OpenPlanning Manifest Schema v1
description: Declares an ordered list of openplanning spec files to load. The `apply` subcommand walks the list, hashes each spec, skips files whose hash already matches an AppliedSpec row, otherwise dispatches to the loader for that spec's `version`. Replaces the long Makefile chain with a single declarative load order. Paths are interpreted relative to the manifest file's directory unless absolute.

name.description: Human-readable label for this manifest, used in command output.

load.description: Ordered list of spec file paths. Each path is loaded in order. Paths may be absolute or relative to the manifest file's directory. Each referenced file must itself be a valid openplanning spec (carries its own `version` field that the loader dispatches on).
